questions.prompt: The chart shows other famous season-opening win streaks. How many straight wins did the 2015–16 Warriors start with?
questions.note: That beat Houston's charted 15–0 start of 1993–94 by nine games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors began the 2015–16 season by winning their first 24 games,

funFacts.text: Assistant Luke Walton coached Golden State's opening stretch while Steve Kerr recovered from back surgery.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors opened the regular season on October 27 with assistant coach Luke Walton coaching

funFacts.text: Milwaukee finally ended the opening streak, with the Bucks handing Golden State its first loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The winning streak to start the season ended at 24 games when they were beaten by the Milwaukee Bucks

funFacts.text: Draymond Green produced a rare five-by-five stat line in the double-overtime win at Boston.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: During this game Draymond Green recorded a five-by-five game

questions.prompt: In 1961–62, guard Oscar Robertson averaged a triple-double for the Royals. How many rebounds per game did he average?
questions.context: Cincinnati Royals · 1961–62 regular season · 6 ft 5 in guard
questions.note: 12.5 to go with 30.8 points and 11.4 assists, from a 6-foot-5 guard.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with 30.8 points, 12.5 rebounds and 11.4 assists.

funFacts.text: He was the first player to average a triple-double over a full season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Robertson became the first player in NBA history to average a triple-double for an entire season

funFacts.text: That season he also broke Bob Cousy's single-season assists record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He broke the assists record by Bob Cousy, who had recorded 715 assists two seasons earlier, by logging 899

funFacts.text: Russell Westbrook became the only other player to do it, with 42 triple-doubles in 2016–17.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Russell Westbrook recorded 42 and joined Robertson as the only other player to average a triple-double for an entire season.

questions.prompt: Top seed Boston won 64 games in 2023–24. How many did the No. 2 seed Knicks win?
questions.context: New York Knicks · 2023–24 · widest 1–2 seed gap in the East since 1976
questions.note: 50, 14 behind Boston: the widest gap between the East's top two seeds since 1976.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: widest margin of wins between the first and second seeds in the Eastern Conference since 1976 at 14 games
source.derivation: Boston 64 wins − 14-win gap to the second seed = 50 wins for New York.

funFacts.text: New York finished second in both the Atlantic Division and the Eastern Conference behind Boston.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the second-place team in the Atlantic Division and the entire Eastern Conference, the New York Knicks.

funFacts.text: In the first round, New York erased a five-point deficit in the final 30 seconds to win Game 2, 104–101.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Knicks overcame a five-point deficit in the final 30 seconds to win 104–101 and take a 2–0 series lead.

funFacts.text: Josh Hart's go-ahead three finished off the 76ers in Game 6.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a wide open Josh Hart made a go-ahead three-pointer to put New York on top as they eliminated the 76ers 4-2.

questions.prompt: Draymond Green led all scorers in Game 7 of the 2016 Finals. How many points did he score?
questions.note: 32 on 6-of-8 threes, with 15 rebounds and nine assists, in a Game 7 loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Draymond Green put up his best performance of the Finals, leading all scorers with 32 points,

funFacts.text: Green shot an outstanding six of eight from beyond the arc in the final game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: including 6-of-8 from three-point range

funFacts.text: His stat line also included 15 rebounds and nine assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: along with 15 rebounds and nine assists

funFacts.text: Kyrie Irving added 26 points for Cleveland during the decisive game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kyrie Irving added 26 points for Cleveland

questions.prompt: Single-game three records from the Finals and regular season are charted. How many threes did Damian Lillard make in a 2021 playoff game?
questions.context: Damian Lillard · Blazers at Nuggets · 2021 playoffs
questions.note: A playoff record, plus 10 assists, and Portland lost anyway.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: behind an NBA playoff record 12 made three-pointers, as well as 10 assists.

funFacts.text: His fifty-five points were a playoff career high.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Lillard scored a playoff career-high 55 points

funFacts.text: He tied it late in regulation and again in overtime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Lillard hit game-tying threes near the end of regulation and near the end of the first overtime

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Nuggets rallied to a 147–140 double-overtime victory to take a 3–2 series lead
